subject: General Knowledge
description: High-hit author-book pairs from the Indian English + international canon

questions.stem: Who wrote the Indian national song 'VANDE MATARAM'?
questions.explanation: Bankim Chandra Chatterjee wrote 'Vande Mataram' as part of his 1882 Bengali novel 'Anandamath'. Tagore wrote 'Jana Gana Mana' (national anthem). Iqbal wrote 'Saare Jahan Se Achha'.
questions.subject: General Knowledge

questions.explanation: Jawaharlal Nehru wrote 'The Discovery of India' while imprisoned in Ahmednagar Fort (1942-1946). 'An Autobiography' (1936) is his earlier major work. 'Glimpses of World History' was written as letters to his daughter Indira.
questions.subject: General Knowledge

questions.stem: Match the BOOK with its AUTHOR. A. Malgudi Days.  B. Midnight's Children.  C. The White Tiger.  D. Train to Pakistan. List-II: 1. R. K. Narayan.  2. Salman Rushdie.  3. Aravind Adiga.  4. Khushwant Singh.
questions.explanation: Narayan — Malgudi Days. Rushdie — Midnight's Children (Booker 1981, Booker of Bookers 1993, Best of the Booker 2008). Adiga — The White Tiger (Booker 2008). Khushwant Singh — Train to Pakistan (novel on Partition).
questions.subject: General Knowledge

questions.stem: The book 'WINGS OF FIRE — An Autobiography' was written by:
questions.explanation: Wings of Fire (1999, with Arun Tiwari) — autobiography of Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam, covering his childhood in Rameswaram to his work on Agni and Prithvi missiles. Other Kalam books: Ignited Minds, India 2020, Indomitable Spirit, Turning Points.
questions.subject: General Knowledge

questions.stem: The book 'ARTHASHASTRA' — a treatise on statecraft and economics — was authored by:
questions.explanation: Kautilya (also called Chanakya or Vishnugupta) — mentor of Chandragupta Maurya (c. 4th century BCE). Arthashastra is a comprehensive manual on governance, economy, law, diplomacy. Rediscovered by R. Shamasastry in 1905.
questions.subject: General Knowledge

questions.stem: 'INDIA WINS FREEDOM' is the autobiography of:
questions.explanation: Maulana Abul Kalam Azad — Congress president 1940-1946 and independent India's first Education Minister. His autobiography 'India Wins Freedom' (1959, posthumous) is a key source on the Partition period.
questions.subject: General Knowledge

questions.stem: The author of 'THE GOD OF SMALL THINGS' — Booker-prize winner 1997 — is:
questions.explanation: Arundhati Roy's debut novel, set in Kerala. Vikram Seth wrote 'A Suitable Boy'; Chetan Bhagat 'Five Point Someone'; Shashi Tharoor 'The Great Indian Novel', 'Why I am a Hindu', etc.
questions.subject: General Knowledge

questions.stem: Match the WORLD-LITERATURE work with its AUTHOR. A. War and Peace.  B. Pride and Prejudice.  C. Das Kapital.  D. The Origin of Species. List-II: 1. Leo Tolstoy.  2. Jane Austen.  3. Karl Marx.  4. Charles Darwin.
questions.explanation: Tolstoy — War and Peace (1869). Austen — Pride and Prejudice (1813). Marx — Das Kapital (1867). Darwin — The Origin of Species (1859).
questions.subject: General Knowledge
